title: Best AI Photo Editing Tools 2026: 12 Tools Compared
summary: The best AI photo editing tools of 2026: 12 editors compared by job, free plan and price, checked on each maker's own pages. Find the one for your photos.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI photo editing tool?


Start from what the photos are for, then check the edits you need most, how the tool counts AI use, and whether you want a subscription or a one-time licence, in that order.


1.


### 1


Name the job


A portrait retouch, a shoot of hundreds of frames, a product listing, a social post or a shot for a film each point to a different kind of tool.


2.


### 2


Pick the edits


Object removal, background swaps, upscaling and edits written as a prompt are spread differently across tools, so check that the ones you use most are on the plan you pay for.


3.


### 3


Count the AI use


Generative credits, AI allowances and monthly credits each run out differently, so price the edits you will actually make in a month, retries included.


4.


### 4


Choose how to pay


A monthly plan, a yearly commitment and a one-time licence with a year of AI tools cost very different amounts over two years.
